name: Onna Kyoushi Otoka "Midara Nawa"
source:
The clever and beautiful Miss Otoka decides to try and solve some bullying going on in the classroom, but her plan backfires and she ends up the victim -- and violated by her pupils! Even worse, the whole thing was witnessed by Kobayashi, an academic advisor!

Kobayashi brands Otoka as a "teacher who entices and seduces her students" and orders a background investigation on her when she denies it. However, little did she know that it was all a despicable trap...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE039940.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
聪明美丽的音香小姐决定尝试解决课堂上发生的一些欺凌行为，但她的计划适得其反，她最终成为受害者 - 并遭到学生的侵犯！更糟糕的是，这一切都被学术顾问小林亲眼目睹了！

小林将乙香称为“引诱学生的老师”，并在她否认后下令对她进行背景调查。然而她却不知道，这一切都是一个卑鄙的陷阱……
